Network.title: Network & DNS
Network.description: Connection diagnostics without passwords or playback URLs.
Network.checkNote: This makes short requests to up to two visible streams without playing video. A server response cannot verify browser codecs or CORS; some failures may only affect this server.

reason.missing: Stream missing or no sample available

Network.corsNote: CORS is controlled by the media server. Manifests, segments and redirects may all need permission for Mosa's origin. Changing the provider DNS does not bypass CORS or transcode video.
Network.localNote: 127.0.0.1 is local. Access from other devices requires a protected, reachable HTTPS server; this does not grant access to a provider subscription.
Network.supportRequest: Please verify whether your streaming server allows playback from the origin {origin}. The browser may require CORS headers on manifests, media segments and redirected resources. No credentials are included.
